title: Moderation research model
description: Social-science moderation model where the moderator points to the hypothesized X-to-Y path rather than to a construct node.

adaptation_notes: Target the moderated path directly instead of drawing a misleading moderator-to-outcome arrow.
Keep the main effect visually dominant and the moderation arrow secondary.
failure_modes: moderation label collides with the main-path label
moderator appears as a direct predictor
the diagram implies a statistically established interaction

locked: the moderator must target a user-supplied path
the diagram does not establish a statistically significant interaction
